authorizationText: La actividad 'Calificación Unidad N' tiene que estar PUBLISHED pero las calificaciones en DRAFT; flujo canónico, idempotente y determinístico. Usuario autoriza expresamente este cierre académico en Classroom.
reason: Implement typed explicit cierreUnidad through the existing HMAC-authenticated WebApp uaqExecutor operation, never through the Site's draft-only actividad authorization. The approved result is exactly one PUBLISHED CourseWork 'Calificación Unidad N' per course/topic, with ONLY StudentSubmission.draftGrade, no assignedGrade or return. Reuse existing 70/30 grade engine. Keep report in Promedios Unidad and avoid redundant writes when draftGrade is unchanged. New read-only and deployment regression guards ensure no accidental publication of student grades. No Sites, manifest or other student coursework changed. Existing ChatGPT Site bridge must separately expose an explicit permission for this PUBLISHED-coursework/DRAFT-grades operation before invocation.
